title: A network pharmacology-based study to investigate the mechanism of curcumin-regulated regenerative repair of quadriceps femoris muscle in KOA rats.
authors: Ye, Hua; Li, Ze-Qin; Yang, Jia-Ming; Long, Yi; Zhong, Yan-Biao; Wu, Yi; Wang, Mao-Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素调控膝骨关节炎大鼠股四头肌再生的网络药理学机制，核心为肌肉萎缩与凋亡通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法为网络药理学与湿实验，无AI/物理模拟，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a very common musculoskeletal disorder, and patients with KOA often exhibit significant quadriceps femoris muscle atrophy. It is well established that curcumin (CUR) exerts protective effects on skeletal muscle. However, the efficacy of CUR in treating KOA-induced quadriceps femoris muscle atrophy and its underlying mechanisms remain uncertain. In this study, we employed network pharmacology to investigate the mechanism by which CUR promotes regenerative repair of the quadriceps femoris muscle in rats with KOA. METHODS: The potential targets of CUR were obtained from Swiss Target Prediction. The targets of skeletal muscle regeneration were identified from GeneCard and OMIM. A Venn diagram was generated to visualize the intersection of CUR targets and skeletal muscle regeneration targets, and the core targets were identified using STRING. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses were conducted using DAVID. Finally, the network pharmacology results were further validated by establishing a KOA rat model using the Hulth method. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking results revealed that CUR affects skeletal muscle regeneration through multiple targets and pathways. In vivo experimental results were validated by demonstrating that KOA causes atrophy and induces apoptosis in the quadriceps femoris muscle. Furthermore, CUR was shown to inhibit apoptosis in the quadriceps femoris muscle by regulating STAT3 and FOS, as well as the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway. CONCLUSIONS: Our study revealed the apoptosis-inhibiting effects of CUR and its underlying mechanisms. Consequently, CUR has the potential to improve quadriceps femoris muscle atrophy caused by KOA.
abstract_zh: 背景：膝骨关节炎（KOA）是一种非常常见的肌肉骨骼疾病，KOA患者常表现出明显的股四头肌萎缩。已明确姜黄素（CUR）对骨骼肌具有保护作用。然而，CUR治疗KOA诱导的股四头肌萎缩的疗效及其潜在机制仍不确定。在本研究中，我们采用网络药理学方法探讨CUR促进KOA大鼠股四头肌再生修复的机制。方法：从Swiss Target Prediction获取CUR的潜在靶点。从GeneCard和OMIM中识别骨骼肌再生的靶点。生成维恩图以可视化CUR靶点与骨骼肌再生靶点的交集，并使用STRING识别核心靶点。利用DAVID进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析。最后，通过采用Hulth法建立KOA大鼠模型，进一步验证网络药理学结果。结果：网络药理学分析和分子对接结果显示，CUR通过多个靶点和通路影响骨骼肌再生。体内实验结果通过证明KOA导致股四头肌萎缩并诱导细胞凋亡得到验证。此外，CUR被证明通过调节STAT3和FOS以及PI3K/AKT信号通路抑制股四头肌细胞凋亡。结论：我们的研究揭示了CUR的抗凋亡作用及其潜在机制。因此，CUR有潜力改善KOA引起的股四头肌萎缩。
